Description:

Job Description:

Hands-on experience with AWS services, especially AWS Bedrock, S3, SQS, Lambda, DynamoDB, IAM, and CloudWatch.
Experience building Generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), preferably Anthropic Claude on AWS Bedrock. Knowledge of RAG, prompt engineering, vector databases, and AI agent frameworks is highly desirable.
Strong Python development experience with frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask and libraries including Boto3, LangChain, and Pandas.
Experience developing serverless and event-driven applications on AWS and integrating cloud-native services.
Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and software development best practices
Strong problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills.
